The response must contain between 30 and 73 words. Why is progrp and nse raise above normal range when petct shows no abnormalityassistant
response: When a proGRP (prohormone-related peptide) and nSE (neuron-specific enolase) level is elevated above the normal range, but a PET (Positron Emission Tomography) scan shows no abnormality, it may indicate a false-positive result. This can occur due to various factors, such as contamination, laboratory error, or a different underlying condition that is not related to cancer. Further testing and evaluation may be necessary to determine the cause of the elevated levels.
